items.title: Marvell Or NVIDIA: Which One Costs Less Per Dollar Of Profit?
items.summary: If you own Marvell Technology (MRVL) or NVIDIA, you own one idea: the world is building AI data centers as fast as the supply chain allows. NVIDIA sells the whole factory and rents its architecture to everybody. Marvell designs the custom parts hyperscalers use to build alternatives to NVIDIA's chips. Same trend, opposite ends, which is why these two belong side by side.
